record.activity: Zero Latency Sol Raiders free-roam competitive experience

classified_object.notes: The classified object is the Sol Raiders-enabled free-roam product/experience configuration, not a formal league or all location-based VR.

performance_agency.summary: Players move, aim, coordinate, and make tactical decisions live inside the shared session.

performance_interface.summary: Wireless headset, controllers, and arena tracking translate full-space movement into the experience.

embodied_performance.summary: Locomotion, balance, sensorimotor coordination, tracked movement, and exertion materially affect play.

arena.summary: A large physical arena is aligned with a shared computational environment for multiple players.

distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Venue tracking and game state synchronize all participants.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Venue mapping and tracking calibration must align physical and virtual boundaries.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Software and venue operators administer the session.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Venue operator controls collision avoidance, boundaries, and emergency response.

sensing_tracking.summary: Advanced motion tracking and real-time proximity systems are central provider-stated functions.

measurement.summary: The product records competitive performance, but public metric definitions and comparability controls are limited.

comparability.summary: Cross-venue hardware, calibration, map version, and operational consistency are not sufficiently documented.

officiation.summary: Game code resolves events while venue staff monitor sessions and safety.

outcome_openness.summary: The in-game competitive result is performance-dependent.

consequence_structure.summary: Winning, losing, tactical resource use, and session results provide in-game consequence.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Physical and computational arenas are jointly operational and safety-coupled. Evidence supports a Spatial Athletic System more strongly than a mature Spatial Athletic Contest.

human_limits_accessibility.note: Boundary alignment and collision systems are central.

source_provisional_finding.summary: The product is a strong Spatial Athletic System candidate because physical and virtual arenas are constitutively coupled, but published evidence is insufficient to establish a mature governed contest class.

content: Public competition rules, metric definitions, cross-venue calibration controls, and appeals procedures.

evidence_sources.source_title: Zero Latency launches the first truly wireless free-roam VR system

record.provenance_note: Per-field claim_class and status preserved verbatim from the source case. source_provisional_finding is the corpus's own attributed reading, not a new Atlas verdict. Provider claims live in evidence_sources; Altis interpretation carries C4/C5.
